import time, random
from operator import add
cap=12; cap1=cap+1
BIG=1<<62
rng=random.Random(1)
def mkvec():
    v=[BIG-rng.randrange(1,10**9)*i for i in range(cap1)]
    return v
LEFTS=[mkvec() for _ in range(64)]
RIGHTS=[mkvec() for _ in range(64)]
N=20000

def A():
    best=[BIG]*cap1; bestk=[0]*cap1
    for k in range(64):
        left=LEFTS[k]; right=RIGHTS[k]; kk=k*cap1
        for c1 in range(cap1):
            a=left[c1]
            for c2 in range(cap-c1+1):
                v=a+right[c2]
                s=c1+c2
                if v<best[s]: best[s]=v; bestk[s]=kk+c1
    return best

def B():
    best=[BIG]*cap1
    for k in range(64):
        left=LEFTS[k]; right=RIGHTS[k]
        rr=right[::-1]
        for c in range(cap1):
            v=min(map(add,left[:c+1],rr[cap-c:]))
            if v<best[c]: best[c]=v
    return best

def C():
    best=[BIG]*cap1
    for k in range(64):
        left=LEFTS[k]; right=RIGHTS[k]
        for c1 in range(cap1):
            a=left[c1]; n=cap1-c1
            seg=best[c1:]
            best[c1:]=[x if x<y else y for x,y in zip(seg,[a+r for r in right[:n]])]
    return best

def D():
    best=[BIG]*cap1
    for k in range(64):
        left=LEFTS[k]; right=RIGHTS[k]; rr=right[::-1]
        cand=[min(map(add,left[:c+1],rr[cap-c:])) for c in range(cap1)]
        best=[x if x<y else y for x,y in zip(best,cand)]
    return best

def E():
    # like A but with local hoisting and while loops
    best=[BIG]*cap1; bestk=[0]*cap1
    for k in range(64):
        left=LEFTS[k]; right=RIGHTS[k]; kk=k*cap1
        c1=0
        while c1<cap1:
            a=left[c1]
            c2=0; s=c1; lim=cap-c1
            while c2<=lim:
                v=a+right[c2]
                if v<best[s]: best[s]=v; bestk[s]=kk+c1
                c2+=1; s+=1
            c1+=1
    return best

for name,f in [("A",A),("B",B),("C",C),("D",D),("E",E)]:
    f(); t=time.time()
    for _ in range(N//64*4): f()
    dt=time.time()-t
    print(name, "%.2f us per k"%(dt/(N//64*4*64)*1e6))
r=[f() for f in (A,B,C,D,E)]
print("same:", all(x==r[0] for x in r[1:]))
PYEOF
